name: Kobold

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls that rely on sight.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

description: Kobolds are small, cowardly reptilian humanoids who rely on numbers, traps, and pack tactics to overwhelm foes they'd never dare face one-on-one.
